traces.answer:
For city driving, efficiency matters most. Among the small cars in the sources, these are ranked by efficiency:

1. BMW i4 eDrive40 Gran Coupe: 118 MPGe, using 28.5 kWh per 100 miles [S5]
2. BMW i4 xDrive40 Gran Coupe: 101 MPGe, using 33.4 kWh per 100 miles [S2]

The M60 costs about $750 a year to run on electricity, based on 15,000 miles [S4]. The Hyundai Ioniq 5 Robo taxi is a small SUV rated very inefficient, so it is a weaker choice [S3].
